verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents card authorization controls that set rules on how and where issued cards can be used, and markets spend controls and spend management. These suggest automatically enforced card-level limits, but nothing in the pack describes department or program budgets, or limits enforced against a budget. Missing for 10: documented department/program budget objects, explicit spend-limit amounts and periods, enforcement of limits at the budget level, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can set department or program budgets with automatically enforced spend limits

citations.quote: Authorization controls allow you to specify rules around how and where the cards you issue may be used.
Control, automate, and reconcile global company spend across expenses and accounts payable.
